Add a new fixer to the cast for an upcoming story beat in Las Flores.

Camila Reyes runs contraband electronics through the neon markets of Distrito
Popular. She is sharp-tongued, quick with a soldering iron, and has a habit of
reading license plates like other people read faces. The scene opens on her at
dusk, the rain slicking the pavement, when a street runner brings her a data
chip that smells like ozone and old betrayal.

She crosses paths with an existing character in the district, the kind of
person who notices when someone new starts moving contraband through her market.
The tone should match the neon-soaked, corporate-grind atmosphere already used
in the canon scenes set in Distrito Popular.
